stateKeys.name: failures
stateKeys.type: integer 0..3, checks that reported a problem

stateKeys.name: reason
stateKeys.type: string, why the run ended without shipping ('' otherwise)

specialRules.name: all-three-report-before-anything-ships
specialRules.note: The three checks run at the same time and report in any order. The run leaves 'checking' only when checksDone reaches 3, and it ships only if none of them failed.

specialRules.name: stale-completions-reject
specialRules.note: A report arriving in a state that does not await it is an observable rejection (post == pre), never a fault. This is what makes at-least-once reporting by several agents safe.
